question: Which of the following dams has been constructed across the river Narmada?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sardar**__** **__**Sarovar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Sardar Sarovar dam** is constructed across the river** Narmada**.
 
• The dam is a **concrete gravity** dam in **Kevadiya, Gujarat**.
 
• The **Foundation stone** of the dam was **laid **by the former prime minister **Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru in 5th April 1961**.
 
• The Dam was inaugurated by **Prime Minister** Narendra Modi in 17th September 2017<
